Evidence: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court ruled that Section 11A of the Central Excise Act 1944 is not applicable when excise duty refunds have been sanctioned by the competent authority and not reversed in appeal. The court stated that recovery proceedings under Section 11A cannot be initiated unless the orders sanctioning the refunds are reversed in appeal (Source 1). This indicates that recovery proceedings cannot occur without prior reversal of the sanctioned refunds, directly contradicting the claim that such proceedings can be initiated without this reversal.
Justification: The evidence from Source 1 clearly states that recovery proceedings under Section 11A of the Central Excise Act cannot be initiated unless the sanctioned refunds are reversed in appeal. This directly contradicts the claim that recovery proceedings can be initiated without such a reversal. Therefore, the evidence refutes the claim.
